notes.text: You can now use a controller extension hook to react to event-driven side effects received using a WebSocket
We now dynamically adjust the decimal padding for currencies based on the currency codelist
We now support merging cells in responsive tables
We've resolved an issue where navigating back to a list report page with inline edit caused the app to terminate unexpectedly
We've resolved an issue where intent-based navigation used an incorrect value for fields with the TextOnly text arrangement
We've resolved an issue where intent-based navigation links in the header of an object page were incorrectly disabled
Table sorting now works correctly when variantManagement is set to None
You can now override the inputFormat of date fields for data exports from the Table building block
We've resolved an issue where pasting data from the clipboard into a table caused columns to incorrectly shift when a measure field referenced a virtual unit of measure
We’ve resolved an issue where analytical tables failed to load when UpdateRestrictions pointed to a navigation property
We now correctly sort an amount column when there are multiple currencies
We've resolved an issue when pasting data into a date range field in a table by ensuring the field supports EditableDisplay
We now ensure that RadioButtons correctly evaluate editable and enabled expressions in tables
We've resolved an issue where create:mandatory and update:readonly fields were incorrectly displayed as read-only in tables with creationMode set to inlineCreationRows or EmptyRow
In the Form building block, FormContainer IDs are now correctly anchored to the enclosing fragment prefix when loaded using loadFragment
We've resolved an issue where table variants weren't displayed on a list report page in multi-view mode
We've resolved an issue where the sort arrow wasn't displayed in headers of grid table columns when variantManagement was set to None
